_comment: Rules used by build_budget.py. Names are matched against Monthly Treasury Statement line descriptions (trailing colons removed). Edit here if Treasury renames a line in a future year.

intragovernmental._comment: Payments from one federal account to another. Both sides are removed from 'spending to the public' so money is not counted twice (e.g. HHS pays the Medicare trust funds, which then pay benefits). They still count toward official net outlays and are shown in the reconciliation.
item_names: Payments to Health Care Trust Funds
Payment to Department of Defense Medicare-Eligible Retiree Health Care Fund
Payment to Civil Service Retirement and Disability Fund
Payments to Social Security Trust Funds

renames.Special Issues (Cash Basis): Interest paid to federal trust funds (special issues)
renames.Public Issues (Accrual Basis): Interest paid to the public (marketable debt)

pivot._comment: Re-nest an agency so the second level becomes the first. DoD is published as Title > Branch; we show Branch > Title.

path_renames._comment: Rename a line only when it sits under a given parent: 'Parent › Line'.
